summary: The @throws tag on updateWith is malformed and must be fixed.

resolved_items.instruction: Rewrite the @throws tag to start with the exception class name, e.g., `@throws Exception if `remappingFunction` throws`.
Drop the @return tag as it restates the description.
Remove the extra blank line between the description and the @param tags.

Clarify that defaultValue is evaluated lazily by changing the @param tag to: `@param defaultValue the value to be computed (lazily) and stored if the key is absent (unless another thread inserts a value first)`.

disagreements.accuracy_position: The @throws tag is malformed and must be rewritten to include the exception class name.
disagreements.style_position: The @throws tag is correct but could be more specific about the exception being rethrown as-is.
disagreements.rationale: The @throws tag is malformed and will not render correctly in Scaladoc without the exception class name.
